preregistered_parameters.aggregation_order: First equal-weight the three regions at each shared origin; then average the 181 days.
preregistered_parameters.estimand: mean QS delta = R20 minus R19; negative favors R20
preregistered_parameters.relative_improvement_percent: -100 * mean paired QS delta / mean R19 QS
preregistered_parameters.sample_construction: Uniform block starts on the 181-day grid; wrap modulo 181; concatenate blocks and truncate to 181 days.
preregistered_parameters.paired_resampling: Identical day indices for R19 and R20; no separate region or arm resampling.
preregistered_parameters.relative_denominator: Recompute the R19 mean within each bootstrap replicate; reject zero denominators rather than dropping replicates.

limitations: This describes the completed development comparison, not an independent blind-test result or a causal effect of the LLM.
Seven-day blocks preserve local serial dependence and shared-day dependence between regions; longer dependence and nonstationarity may remain.
Circular wrapping joins the end of the development interval to its beginning as a resampling approximation.
A percentile interval excluding zero does not establish an independently validated gain after development or model/skill selection.
No block-length search, one-sided test, or outcome-dependent stopping is performed.
